Thanks for the earlier sync. CloudForge is ready to run a joint co-sell demo that highlights the Marketplace listing and the SI integration (SI: CloudForge). AWS is looped on this CC to confirm a PM/SA to attend.

Proposed 1-hour slots (all PT):
- Wed Jun 23, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu Jun 24, 14:00–15:00 PT
- Mon Jun 28, 08:30–09:30 PT

High-level agenda (attached):
- 10 min intros & expected attendees
- 20 min Redwood product walkthrough (hosted + Dedicated + Private notes)
- 20 min CloudForge SI integration demo (data flow + deployment runbook)
- 10 min Q&A / next steps / marketplace listing cadence

Attachments: CF_Redwood_AWS_demo_agenda.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

Can you confirm which slot works and whether Redwood wants to own the initial recording + Marketplace listing notes? Also, do you need any test accounts or demo tenants pre-provisioned?

Best,

Hi Anna — great, thanks for sending the options.

Quick answers up front: we can run the 1-hour format and Redwood will own the recording + initial Marketplace listing notes. We do need a short run-of-show (final slide order + who demos which screen) and any test accounts by EOD two business days before the demo.

From an availability perspective: the team I want to loop in is Karthik (partner engineering lead) and Vanessa (marketplace & co-sell ops). Karthik / Vanessa — can you confirm whether you have capacity for the proposed slots? If the AWS PM needs a specific window for EMEA/APAC overlap we can try to accommodate.

If it helps, my preference is Wed Jun 23, 10:00–11:00 PT. If AWS needs slightly earlier for APAC coverage we can consider Jun 28 08:30 PT as a fallback.

Linking the HubSpot deal for context: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/54321 (CloudForge - Marketplace listing)

Attaching a first-pass Redwood deck for pacing: Redwood_demo_slides_v1.pdf

Thanks — I can lock once Karthik/Vanessa confirm and once AWS confirms an attendee.

Cheers,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com

- Please confirm any IP/networking constraints for a shared demo tenant (firewall rules / IP allowlist).

I attached a short runbook template I typically ask partners to fill out — it will speed up pre-demo provisioning: runbook-template.md

- 09:30–09:35 PT: Quick intros & attendee roll call (Stephanie / Anna / AWS SA)
- 09:35–09:50 PT: Redwood demo — hosted API, model routing, and Marketplace listing notes (Stephanie)
- 09:50–10:05 PT: CloudForge SI demo — deployment/runbook, data flow, and customer ops (Anna)

- 10:20–10:30 PT: Wrap / confirm recording ownership and follow-ups (Redwood will own recording; CloudForge will own SI collateral)

Pre-demo checklist (action owners):
- CloudForge: share test tenant + any sample data (deadline: Jun 21 EOD)
- Redwood (Karthik): confirm demo tenant access and any allowlist rules (deadline: Jun 21 EOD)
- Vanessa: prepare the Marketplace listing checklist and the initial copy for AWS review (deadline: Jun 22 EOD)

Attachments: final-demo-slide-deck.pdf (finalized slides), runbook-template.md (filled by CloudForge expected by Jun 21).

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=demo-invite-123
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/54321

If anything changes on the AWS attendee front please flag ASAP. Otherwise I will send the official calendar invite and recording instructions this afternoon.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to it.
